name: Protection IED (illustrative)
description: A generic line-protection IED at firmware 4.2.0, as its supplier would describe it. Ten interfaces, described from the outside. Values are illustrative.
comment: NON-CONFORMING EXAMPLE. The protection IED record with verifierReplaceable left out on the firmware update interface. Fails pqc-migration-ot#I4 only: the operator cannot tell whether the device can be updated or has to be replaced.

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Layer-2 multicast with a 3 ms transfer time for trip messages (IEC 61850-5 P2/P3). A per-message signature does not fit: ML-DSA-44 signatures are 2,420 bytes. Already symmetric.

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Layer-2 multicast within the sampling interval. Already symmetric.

attributes.name: algorithmSelection
values: Groups and signature schemes limited to those IEC 62351-3:2023 profiles

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Conformance to IEC 62351-3 permits only the groups and signature schemes it lists, and it lists no post-quantum ones.

attributes.name: algorithmSelection
values: Token signature algorithm set by the access token issuer

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Carried over tls-mms. The token signature is what grants authority.

attributes.name: algorithmSelection
values: Set by the key server's group policy

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: The key plane for GOOSE and SV. GDOI over IKEv1 phase 1 (RFC 8052). Its successor G-IKEv2 (RFC 9838) is not profiled by IEC 62351-9:2023, which provides no post-quantum measures.

attributes.name: algorithmSelection
values: Certificate profile set by the enrolment service

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Device identity certificates with long validity.

attributes.name: algorithmSelection
values: Firmware signature algorithm fixed by the bootloader

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Firmware images are signed ECDSA-P256-SHA256 and verified by the bootloader.

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Protected by TLS and access control. The configuration file itself is not signed.

interfaces.name: Device private key and trust anchors

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Whether a secure element holds the device key is under evaluation.

rules.text: Every interface it applies to states verifierReplaceable
rules.note: Whether the algorithm the device uses to verify new firmware, with its trust anchor, can change in the field ('in-field'), only through a bootloader update ('bootloader-update'), or not at all because it is fixed in boot ROM ('not-replaceable'). Splits a fleet into devices that can be updated and devices that must be replaced.

fix: State verifierReplaceable on upd-fw. Use one of: in-field, bootloader-update, not-replaceable.
